translation: For example, when one travels in the mountains and alone meets a fine scene, one joyfully returns and tells of it, not aware of its disorder. My vast and hasty heart of helping growth only wants people to know that rubbing can be done, and to do it as well; the words are only a general outline and cannot convey the meaning. If there are truly those who do it, then they will attain the Way and obtain it themselves, and there must be another realm, like on the Shanyin road where one cannot respond to all; the scene also extends the meaning of sharing the good, telling it to later people, and there is a surplus of teachers. Would I have leisure to consider whether my words are right or wrong? Otherwise, one will say that the paths of the mountain trails and byways must have no reason to be blocked by grass; then my words are even more like having and not having.
